messages:
maya (prod PM): Heads-up: Atlas asked for a pin exception and a shadowing opt-in while they finish regression tests. Need quick alignment on TTLs, canary safety nets, and the exact customer-facing language. TL;DR below, please skim and flag blockers.

aj (eng): quick Q: is Atlas on hosted or dedicated? that changes routing options.

maya (prod PM): hosted. they may upgrade to dedicated if we require a hard pin beyond 90d.

selene (research): perf context from smokebench run (rtx-a6000, seq512):
```
aurora-lite: p50 46ms, p95 158ms (baseline target p95<=150ms)
with q4_0: p95 138ms, tiny QA drop on summarization (0.6% absolute)
pegasus-embed (t4): mean embed=11.5ms, cosine vs canon=0.892
```
notes: embed stability looks okay but we should lock schema for embed customers.

samir (sde): engineering constraints and options:
- soft pin (no infra changes): up to 90d, routing sticky but fallback allowed in emergencies.
- extended soft pin via opt-in SLA: +30d extension possible via console checkbox + audit log
- hard pin (>=180d): requires reserved capacity + sales/legal contract + infra flag

nora (support): Atlas wants "no silent cut" promise. we can promise proactive comms and a 48h notice before non-emergency reroutes. need wording for the portal.

maya (prod PM): propose customer-facing phrasing (draft):
"Soft pin (90 days): Redwood will route your traffic to the selected model variant. In emergency situations (e.g., critical runtime errors or safety incidents) we may reroute to a fallback model; Redwood will notify the primary contact and provide a remediation plan. To request an extension beyond 90 days, customers can opt into a temporary SLA via the Console. Hard pins (>=180 days) require a reserved capacity agreement."

aj (eng): can we define "emergency" concretely? ops needs numeric triggers.

samir (sde): propose concrete rollback triggers for canary and runtime:
- runtime error-rate > 0.5% (5xxs or model panics)
- p95 latency > 2x baseline over 30m window
- automated eval regression: metric drop > 1.0% absolute on task-specific probe
- cost delta: > 15% at 25% traffic OR tenant daily token cost delta > $2k

selene (research): add mandatory long-tail eval slice (5% of bench) and multi-turn continuity probe. we had silent regressions on that last quarter.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary template and metrics hooks: https://internal.redwood/ops/canary-template :rocket:

maya (prod PM): operational plan proposal:
- default: 90-day soft pin
- console opt-in: +30d extension when customer checks SLA box and accepts terms
- >90 days: require sales + infra approval; recommend dedicated capacity for >=180d
- canary: staged roll (1% -> 5% over 48h -> 25% over 72h), auto-checks for error-rate, latency, eval regression, cost delta
- embed-specific: require schema lock + mean cosine >= 0.88 vs baseline on smokebench

nora (support): i'll add field "requested TTL" and "shadowing opt-in" to the pin request form, and include the customer-facing blurb above. also will prepare a support playbook for "pin expiration" reminders at 14d/7d/1d.

aj (eng): dev question: do we want an automatic abort if cost delta > X at 5% traffic, or only at 25%? sampler suggests check earlier.

samir (sde): add early-warning cost threshold: if cost delta > 8% at 5% traffic -> pause ramp and require manual review. full abort condition remains >15% at 25% or $2k/day delta.

selene (research): agreed on early warning. also require a short explanation field on the pin form for customers to state why they need the pin. helps triage.

maya (prod PM): decision checklist for this thread (what i'll publish if we agree):
- Acceptance gates: smokebench perf (hosted p95 <=150ms OR documented quant tradeoff) + eval passrate within -2% abs + long-tail probe + embed stability >=0.88
- TTLs: 90d soft pin, +30d opt-in via console SLA, >90d needs contract (180d+ => reserved capacity)
- Canary policy: 1% -> 5% -> 25% staged ramp; rollback triggers (error-rate 0.5%, p95 2x, eval drop 1% abs, cost delta rules) + early-warning cost check at 5% (8%)
- Customer comms: explicit "soft vs hard pin" wording + 48h non-emergency notice promise

samir (sde): INF-1321 created for canary eval hooks and cost checks. estimate: 2 days eval hooks, 3 days cost + console wiring.

nora (support): drafting comms. will include sample language and FAQ: e.g., "What happens at TTL end?" -> "We will notify and recommend options: extend via console, migrate to new variant, or purchase reserved capacity."

aj (eng): :white_check_mark:

selene (research): :white_check_mark: adding long-tail slice to bench run

samir (sde): :white_check_mark: starting INF-1321

nora (support): :white_check_mark: drafting pin form + playbook

maya (prod PM): thanks team. i'll update the catalog onboarding doc and the pin request form tonight. tagging this as internal decision for v1 TTL + canary requirements. if anything urgent pop into #product for follow-up.
